svg.title: Figure AB-4. Common air-brake warning lamps
svg.desc: Lamp meaning from CA Commercial Driver Handbook DL 650 (REV 12/2019) §§5.1.6–5.1.7 and 5.2.7. Shapes and colors are study symbols only, not official DMV or manufacturer artwork.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure AB-4. Common air-brake warning lamps

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Schematic study lamps — not official ISO or OEM icons. What the handbook says to do matters more than the exact artwork on a given truck.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: If it comes on and stays on while driving, the ABS may not be working. You still have ordinary

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: A red light and/or buzzer must warn you before air falls below 55 psi (commonly 80–85 psi on

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: some large buses). Stop and park as soon as it is safe. (DL 650 §5.1.6, 5.3.)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Spring (parking) brakes come fully on between about 20 and 45 psi if pressure keeps falling.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not wait for that — stop when the low-air warning first sounds. (DL 650 §5.1.7.)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: On vehicles required to have it, a separate lamp warns of a trailer ABS problem. The trailer

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: can still be braked. Have the system checked. (DL 650 §5.2.7.)
